prompt:
ORTHOGRAPHIC VERTICAL OVERHEAD PLAN VIEW. Camera directly above, looking straight down into the object from above. Rectangular edges run horizontally and vertically on the canvas. Show no vertical outside faces.

Create an ORIGINAL game building sprite for the D'thorga bulk bunker: an open concrete storage bay that a dump truck reverses up to and tips stone into, in a hard-scrabble frontier colony. Image 1 is our approved vehicle parts bench from the same family of buildings: match its outline weight, shading, palette and finish only. Do NOT copy its shape or contents. Image 2 is our rough layout drawing of this bunker: keep its layout only and redraw it in the finished style.

Tall canvas. The bunker fills about 92 percent of the canvas width and 94 percent of its height, centred, on a plain pure white background. It is four units long from top to bottom and three units wide.

Its plan: a flat, empty, pale grey concrete floor slab with faint expansion joints, one unit apart. Thick poured-concrete walls with a steel cap along their inner edge run along the top, left and right sides. The bottom side is open: across it lies a low steel wheel stop painted with worn yellow and dark diagonal hazard stripes. One small plain steel drain grate is set in the floor near the top wall. A faint worn patch on the floor shows where loads are tipped.

Style: a sprite for the game RimWorld: a thick near-black outline around every shape, soft flat cel shading with two or three tones per material, pale panels, a few small clean details, no texture noise. Not a photograph, not a 3D render, not pixel art.

No stone, rocks, chunks, rubble, goods, people, animals, vehicles, tools, text, letters, numbers, logos, dials, screens or dust. No ground beyond the bunker, no shadow outside it, no perspective, no tilt.
